name: Truthifi
description: One verified household record for your AI: accounts, activity, holdings, fees, performance, cash flow, the advisors on your accounts, financial diagnostics, and your Truthifi Score with the findings behind it. Can't move money.
author: Truthifi

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: Lists your linked accounts, and how far back each one's data goes

tools.name: get_groups
tools.description: Your account groups, goals and wealth buckets

tools.name: get_advisors
tools.description: Financial advisors linked to your accounts, with details from public regulatory records

tools.name: get_dated_holdings
tools.description: Your positions in each account on one day (the latest by default)

tools.name: get_composition
tools.description: How your portfolio splits by asset class, sector, industry or country (top 10 of each)

tools.name: get_equity_concentrations
tools.description: Your exposure to individual stocks, including what you hold through funds

tools.name: get_market_cap_allocation
tools.description: How your portfolio splits across market-cap sizes, for stocks and funds separately

tools.name: get_balance_history
tools.description: Opening and closing balance for each account over a date range

tools.name: get_performance_history
tools.description: Return, income and gain or loss over a date range, compared with a similar benchmark

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: Fees per account, by type: maintenance, margin interest, advisory, commissions, fund fees

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Individual transactions, filterable and paged

tools.name: get_budget_flow_summary
tools.description: Spending and income by period and category (excludes card payments and investment income)

tools.name: get_investment_transactions_summary
tools.description: Buys, sells, dividends and other investment activity, totalled by period

tools.name: get_asset_liabilities
tools.description: Assets and liabilities you track by hand, such as a home, a car or a mortgage

tools.name: create_asset_liability
tools.description: Adds one asset or liability you track by hand. Shows a preview first, and saves only after you confirm

tools.name: delete_asset_liability
tools.description: Permanently deletes one asset or liability you track by hand

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: The financial health findings behind your Truthifi Score

tools.name: get_truthifi_score_history
tools.description: Your Truthifi Score over time

tools.name: get_security_info
tools.description: Reference details for up to 15 securities per call (fewer on some plans)

tools.name: get_security_distributions
tools.description: Dividend and capital-gain history for up to 15 securities per call (fewer on some plans), up to 2 years back

tools.name: get_security_news
tools.description: Recent news by stock ticker or by topic (stock tickers only, not funds)

tools.name: get_truthifi_info
tools.description: Answers questions about Truthifi, linking accounts and US personal-finance benchmarks

tools.name: run_scan
tools.description: Refreshes one connection's data right now, instead of waiting for the automatic refresh

tools.name: get_scan_status
tools.description: Checks how a refresh is going

tools.name: get_subscription_info
tools.description: Your plan, credits used, and which tools you can use

tools.name: get_subscription_catalog
tools.description: Every Truthifi plan, with its price, connection limit, features and MCP credits, so you can compare plans

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Gives you a secure link to connect a new bank or brokerage account

tools.name: fix_connections
tools.description: Gives you a link to fix bank or brokerage connections that aren't refreshing (only when one needs fixing)

tools.name: upgrade
tools.description: Gives you a link to the plan picker, when a higher plan exists

tools.name: get_prompt_catalog
tools.description: Ready-made step-by-step prompts, such as a fee audit, a spending review or a tax preview. Instructions only, never account data
